title: The Grand Engine

reward.description: The beating heart of the Grand Engine: a sphere of blue-white light in a cage of brass. The whole city hums in tune with it.

hints: reachable: keep a set of visited chambers and a list to explore. Pop a chamber, add every neighbour you haven't visited yet.
shortest_route: breadth-first search finds the fewest pipes. Use collections.deque as a queue, and remember each chamber's 'came_from' parent so you can rebuild the path at the end.
isolated: every chamber in the network that isn't in reachable(network, boiler). Remember to sort the result.
